connection.purpose: Open known schema; enforce FK/WAL/FULL; create session input_player; own read snapshot lifetime
connection.grain_keys: One connection; schema version; input_player PK player_key
connection.null_duplicates: Unknown/nonempty version-0 DB rejected; temp player keys unique and non-NULL
connection.transaction: Schema initialization only on empty DB; writers hold flock. read_snapshot begins only when no transaction exists and rolls back only that owned read transaction on success/error; borrowed read/write transactions remain caller-owned
connection.verification: tests/test_ops.py; tests/test_ops_review.py schema rejection; tests/test_ops_snapshots.py ownership, nested reads and error cleanup

registration.purpose: Register immutable batch input snapshot and deduplicated jobs
registration.null_duplicates: Required metadata non-NULL; ON CONFLICT job_id reuses only matching metadata; batch mismatch rejected

batch-read.transaction: Operations query snapshot or existing caller/writer transaction; the query ends only a snapshot it started

recovery.purpose: Recover abandoned RUNNING attempts and jobs
recovery.grain_keys: All RUNNING attempts and jobs in state DB
recovery.null_duplicates: Interrupted elapsed remains NULL; repeated recovery has no extra history
recovery.transaction: One transaction after exclusive process lock proves old worker exited

processing.purpose: Claim, parse, SQL parity, persist results and success; then record latency
processing.null_duplicates: attempt_no=MAX+1 or 1; successful elapsed NULL until post-commit write; no partial results on failure; duplicate result keys rejected
processing.transaction: Claim transaction; BEGIN IMMEDIATE results+signal+case+SUCCEEDED; separate latency transaction. Database failure halts worker
processing.indexes: PKs; combat_attack partial index; temp player PK; no optimization before baseline
processing.verification: tests/test_ops.py crash, checksum, SQL mismatch and DB failure tests; tests/test_ops_review.py

ops-compute.purpose: Reconstruct R2 counts and statistics independently from combat projection
ops-compute.grain_keys: One player_key per job; binds job_id, legacy, min_attacks, min_pool, min_signal_pool,z_hit
ops-compute.null_duplicates: EXISTS prevents duplicate attacks multiplying damage; positive linked damage only in context protocol; LEFT JOIN preserves no combat players; ratios NULL at zero attacks; constant SD 1e-9; ordered player_key
ops-compute.transaction: Inside result transaction; temp input_player contains only current match
ops-compute.indexes: combat PK for job scan; combat_attack for EXISTS; temp B-trees for group/window/order

work.purpose: Read queued jobs in stable order
work.grain_keys: batch_job -> job, one job per batch membership
work.transaction: Writer lock across work; per-job transaction
work.indexes: batch_job PK, job PK/job_state; actual query plans in evidence

retry.purpose: Explicitly requeue a failed member job
retry.null_duplicates: EXISTS membership; exactly one FAILED row required, other states rejected
retry.transaction: Single transaction under writer lock; past attempts/results untouched

status.purpose: Read batch jobs and attempts for counts and measured latency
status.grain_keys: Ordered job and attempt rows in a batch
status.null_duplicates: NULL successful latency excluded; sample count explicit; batch membership does not multiply rows
status.transaction: One Operations read_snapshot for batch/jobs/attempts; nested report or existing caller transaction reused without commit/rollback
status.indexes: batch_job PK; job/attempt PK; sort by match or time

report.purpose: Aggregate R2 strata, errors and latest retries; load evidence and provenance
report.grain_keys: map/mode/status; stage/error; latest attempt per job; signal; match
report.null_duplicates: Only SUCCEEDED for denominators; error NULL excluded; ROW_NUMBER per job; stable sorting; no review notes in detection report
report.transaction: Public facade holds writer flock. One read_snapshot covers status and report rows; owned snapshot ends before atomic files/final manifest, borrowed transaction lifetime remains with caller
report.indexes: batch_job, job, player_match, attempt and signal PKs; group/window temp B-trees

cli.purpose: Reserved historical contract: CLI delegates status snapshot lifetime to Operations; no current SQL execution site
cli.grain_keys: No current SQL rows or direct BEGIN
cli.null_duplicates: Not applicable; query contracts own returned rows
cli.transaction: CLI owns connection lifetime only; see connection and status contracts

benchmark.purpose: Capture actual compute query plan and canonical synthetic actor results
benchmark.grain_keys: Plan step; job match; player actor; signal actor/rule
benchmark.null_duplicates: Unknown actor rejected; canonical sorting; same-version exact hashes, cross-version float tolerance 1e-9
benchmark.transaction: After measured run/report processes exit; excluded from timing
benchmark.indexes: EXPLAIN of actual protocol/job parameters; PK result reads

ops-schema.grain_keys: Each CREATE names its table and PK/FK; attempt per job+number, signal per job+player+rule, review case per signal, history per case+sequence
ops-schema.null_duplicates: NOT NULL, CHECK IS TRUE and PK/UNIQUE reject incomplete success and duplicate identities; NULL latency means unmeasured
ops-schema.transaction: New empty DB only; version mismatch rejected without migration
ops-schema.indexes: Explicit indexes and implicit PK/UNIQUE; see each statement

audit-schema.purpose: Immutable research audit projection, dimensions, fact and five views
audit-schema.grain_keys: run_id; staged observation; player; match; fact observation; artifact path; lineage source edge
audit-schema.null_duplicates: State CHECK IS TRUE rejects UNKNOWN; valid skipped NULL retained; unique player/match mapping; window first evaluated and recursive path cycle checks
audit-schema.transaction: In-memory schema; staged load transaction; transform BEGIN IMMEDIATE/COMMIT
audit-schema.indexes: Declared PK/UNIQUEs; implicit view underlying indexes
audit-schema.verification: tests/test_sql_audit.py all constraints and 13 Gold parity checks

audit-load.purpose: Load checksum-validated observations/artifacts and transform to audit dimensions/views
audit-load.grain_keys: run metadata; observation_id; artifact_path; (artifact,source) edge; aggregate counts
audit-load.null_duplicates: 22 staging columns; conflicting dimension attributes fail FK; duplicate identities rejected; no persistent DB
audit-load.transaction: In-memory only; staged inserts with connection; script owns transform transaction

audit-read.purpose: Read aggregate views for comparison with frozen Gold
audit-read.grain_keys: run aggregate; rank_decile or map key
audit-read.null_duplicates: Empty aggregate rejected; deciles include zeros; only evaluated rows enter rates; ORDER BY supplied key

review-read.purpose: List/filter case state or retrieve signal and ordered append-only history
review-read.null_duplicates: Optional filters bound; EXISTS batch membership avoids duplicates; missing case/batch rejected; stable case order
review-read.transaction: One Operations read_snapshot; own BEGIN and rollback on success/error if no transaction existed, otherwise reuse caller transaction without ending it
review-read.indexes: review_case PK and signal UNIQUE; review_history PK; batch_job PK
review-read.verification: tests/test_ops_review.py filtering, state and evidence; tests/test_ops_snapshots.py repeated queries, missing rows, DB errors and pending writes

review-write.purpose: Atomically record start/note/complete/reopen and operator label
review-write.null_duplicates: Empty inputs and invalid transitions rejected; notes append; no update/delete history; operator is local label, not authentication
review-write.transaction: BEGIN IMMEDIATE under same writer flock; state and history commit together
review-write.verification: tests/test_ops_review.py transition, crash and replay preservation

backup.purpose: SQLite online backup to a new file and integrity/FK check
backup.grain_keys: Entire state database including review history
backup.null_duplicates: Existing destination rejected; no automatic DB migration
backup.transaction: Writer lock plus SQLite backup consistent snapshot
backup.indexes: Not query optimization; PRAGMA integrity_check and foreign_key_check

test.purpose: Regression assertion, deliberate fault injection, or test-only SQL wrapper
test.grain_keys: See enclosing named test and literal SQL; fixtures are synthetic
test.null_duplicates: Tests assert valid NULL/duplicates and rejection boundaries, never production input
test.transaction: Temporary DBs; test wrappers may kill before/after commit
test.indexes: Inherited fixture schema; no production index changes
test.verification: Source test is executable evidence; embedded child scripts included in inventory
